sloka: अपसव्यं ततः कुर्वन् रावणस्य महारथम् ।चक्रोत्क्षिप्तेन रजसा रावणं व्यवधानयत् ।। ६.१०८.१५ ।।
transliteration: apasavyaṁ tataḥ kurvan rāvaṇasya mahāratham ।cakrotkṣiptena rajasā rāvaṇaṁ vyavadhānayat ।। 6.108.15 ।।

translations.english: Matali, the best charioteer of the Devatas, was highly delighted at Rama's words and started driving.
